Excellent experience
Feb 2026 • Family
We visited Good Morning Vietnam several times over he past holiday visits, yesterday with the entire family (4 adults, a Teenager and a kid of 2 years)
So lots of challenges like Baby food first, then salad for half of us, then Pasta/Pizza and the legendary Semi-Freddo for all.
The wonderful caring and attentive staff, excellent authentic italian food (I know what I am talking, my parents lived in Italy for centuries), great hospitality and a female Restaurant Manager who knows what a great dining experience looks like!

Thank you to all staff and the Manager for making it a perfect dining experience. 

We definitively come back next holidays.

Friendly Staff and Delicious Food!
Dec 2018 • Couples
Came here for lunch on a cold, misty day. Can imagine the view would be incredible if it was clear! The food was really great, had a duck curry and a catfish hot plate. Both were very generous portions and the flavours were fantastic. The homemade hot sauce was the best bit though, loved it! The staff offered us unlimited rice and a great homemade chilli sauce, which we loved! The place is great, they had a little fire going with some amazing smells coming from it. The staff were so friendly and chatty, really made us feel like we were at home. Stayed for a while drinking ginger tea to warm up (again given complimentary). Seriously recommend this place for great Vietnamese food and exceptional service in Sapa!
